note: What a server sends to give a unit's resource bar colours of its own, or to take them back. The header names the unit.

fields.name: unused
fields.note: Unused; its bytes carry no meaning. The header names the unit.

fields.name: on
fields.note: Nonzero gives the bar the two colours below; zero takes them back, and a client reads neither.

fields.name: fill
fields.note: The colour the bar fills with up to the unit's current amount, with its alpha in the top byte, which the bar's own fading scales.

fields.name: lost
fields.note: The colour of what the unit has just lost, drawn from its current amount up to a mark that falls back toward it over time; alpha as above.
